Officer Login and Card Order

Beneficiary Dashboard, 7 Oct 2026 — built in code, then Figma.

Officer Login — desktop

One centred card on a quiet ground: emblem, “Officer Login”, “Beneficiary Dashboard”. The two-sentence scope paragraph is gone, as are the icons inside the fields. Built from the design system’s standard login card.

Officer Login — wrong User ID or password

A refused sign-in is one alert above the fields, not a red User ID field — the reader can’t tell which of the two was wrong, and naming one tells a stranger which IDs exist.

Officer Login — nothing entered

Empty fields still get their own message under each field.

Officer Login — phone

On a phone the grey frame is dropped, so the card gets the full width.

Department and Portal Dashboards

The Department’s card comes first and spans the row, with its trend line beside its four figures. The five portal cards follow: NMBA and SMILE, then e-Utthaan, e-Anudaan and Senior Citizens.

Department and Portal Dashboards — tablet (1024)

At tablet width the Department card keeps its two halves; NMBA takes the next row.

Department and Portal Dashboards — phone

On a phone every card stacks, the Department first.

Figma — Officer Login, wrong User ID or password (new screen)

A new handoff screen for the refused sign-in. The button is navy in Figma because the build runs in the DBIM colour mode, which by standing rule is never added to Figma.
